lead.title: AstraZeneca and Oracle launch a global AI collaboration, from trial recruitment to safety monitoring
lead.deck: The two groups signed a non-binding term sheet to test AI tools connecting research to care pathways: clinical trial recruitment, earlier diagnosis, drug-safety monitoring and use of real-world data on deidentified data. The first program is in Abu Dhabi, on uncontrolled hypertension with M42, followed by projects in Europe; no financial terms were disclosed.

milestone.title: NeuroXT wins FDA 510(k) clearance for NEXT-Cue, an AI software for prognosis in mild cognitive impairment
milestone.summary: The Class II software as a medical device combines brain MRI, demographic data and cognitive assessment to help clinicians estimate the risk of progression to Alzheimer's dementia within five years. The South Korean company plans to build real-world use cases at leading US institutions.
milestone.why: Prognosis in mild cognitive decline is becoming a software market as anti-amyloid treatments arrive: knowing who progresses guides who to treat. A comparable for European brain-imaging SaMDs.

brefsEurope.title: Tivenix signs a strategic partnership agreement with CellCarta expanding their 2025 regulatory collaboration
brefsEurope.summary: The agreement includes joint clinical studies and a joint commercial offering for the Swiss company's AI platform, which analyzes cell-free DNA and starts with neurodegenerative diseases. CellCarta is a precision medicine contract research organization.

word.fr: Automatic identification of patients eligible for a trial
word.definition: Software, often based on language models, that reads a patient's record to spot the clinical trials they could join.

parts.label: Patient data
parts.role: structured medical record and free-text clinical notes

parts.label: Trial criteria
parts.role: the protocol's inclusion and exclusion rules

parts.label: Matching engine
parts.role: the model that crosses both and ranks candidates

how.t: The system analyzes unstructured documents (in several languages) and structured clinical variables from the patient record.
A model evaluates each patient against the inclusion and exclusion criteria of open trials.
The list of candidate trials goes to the clinician, who confirms eligibility and proposes enrollment.

word.why: VC angle: recruitment is the first cause of trial delays, hence a budget that sponsors and pharma pay for (AstraZeneca is testing AI for recruitment with Oracle). Startups that plug into hospital patient records get direct data access; the barrier is health-data compliance.
